title: Lanyard Platform compatibility pins (schema_version 2)
description: Immutable pin set for Portal images, backend runtime artifacts, and client-core seed. schema_version 2 replaces top-level hermes.* with backend.* (kind, version, url, sha256, contract majors). client_core remains a separate top-level block. No live git branches as versions.

schema_version.description: Pin document schema major. Version 2 is the platform monorepo shape (backend block). Bump only with breaking field changes.

meta.description: Optional operator notes. Not consumed by bootstrap install logic.

backend.description: Selected backend product artifact. Replaces schema_version 1 hermes.* pins. Align kind/version/contract with the artifact's manifest/backend.json (contracts/backend-runtime-v1).

kind.description: Backend product family. Must match manifest kind and backend-runtime-v1.

version.description: Immutable release label (e.g. v0.1.0). Not a git branch.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the backend tarball bytes. Plain 64-hex or sha256: prefix both accepted.

url.description: s3:// or https:// object URL for the backend release tarball (backend.tar.gz or product-equivalent archive). Prefer arch-labeled object keys (…/<arch>/…) once labeled objects exist; do not silently fall back to unlabeled hermes/<version>/… paths.

arch.description: CPU/OS platform label for the pinned backend runtime tarball (native wheels). Default product path is linux-x86_64 (mocklab / typical EC2). Optional linux-aarch64 only when an arm pack was published. Maps to Terraform backend_artifact_arch and env BACKEND_ARTIFACT_ARCH; product workflow may echo hermes.target_arch / hermes.arch with the same value. Operators must set arch intentionally and pin the matching arch-labeled URL.

signature_b64.description: Optional base64 raw Ed25519 signature over artifact bytes (maps to BACKEND_ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE_B64; legacy HERMES_ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE_B64).

contract.description: Contract majors the pinned backend claims. Must agree with manifest/backend.json contract fields. relay supersedes schema_version 1 top-level relay_contract.major.

runtime_layout.description: Backend home filesystem layout major (v1 = BACKEND_HOME layout).

relay.description: Relay protocol major. Translated from v1 relay_contract.major (when that was 0, use 1 as the v1 platform floor).

brain_rpc.description: Brain RPC method-set major implemented by this backend.

client_core.description: Client-core seed tarball (arch-neutral content/seed; no native-wheel arch label required unless native deps appear later). Always a separate top-level block — never nested under backend. Install target remains the vault root, independent of selected backend kind.

version.description: Immutable release label. Not a git branch.

url.description: s3:// or https:// client-core.tar.gz object URL.

signature_b64.description: Optional base64 raw Ed25519 signature over artifact bytes (maps to CLIENT_CORE_ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE_B64).

portal.description: Portal static web pin and/or container image pins. Unchanged from schema_version 1 shape.

web.description: Optional static SPA pin (portal-web tarball). Preferred over a web runtime container.

version.description: Immutable release label. Not a git branch.

url.description: s3:// or https:// portal-web.tar.gz object URL.

signature_b64.description: Optional base64 raw Ed25519 signature over artifact bytes.

repository.description: Image repository without mutable tag as the sole pin.

tag.description: Optional human label; digest is authoritative.

artifact_attestation.description: Optional Ed25519 publisher attestation. SHA-256 pins remain required. Carried over from schema_version 1.

alg.description: Signature algorithm; only ed25519 is implemented offline via openssl pkeyutl.

signing_pubkey_b64.description: Base64 of PEM public key (maps to ARTIFACT_SIGNING_PUBKEY_B64).

signing_identity.description: Optional human label for the release key (maps to ARTIFACT_SIGNING_IDENTITY).

require.description: When true, map to REQUIRE_ARTIFACT_ATTESTATION=1 (fail-closed if sig/pubkey missing).
